slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: the Seychelles' signature granite-boulder beach as a wedding setting, signalling luxury ahead of a practical legal guide.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2 with room for a title overlay. Ceremony set-up (arch or aisle, white florals) on a white sand beach framed by smooth pink-grey granite boulders and clear turquoise shallows, at a real, named Seychelles resort or a beach where the venue holds ceremonies, golden-hour light, no signage. Beach and island named only if proven by the source (do not assume Anse Source d'Argent or any named beach from appearance). Couple optional and small in frame. People only from a licensed real wedding with written couple consent (and guest consent if identifiable) recorded in library-index.csv; never AI people, never stock models presented as a real couple. No cultural or religious practice shown unless from a consented real wedding. Source order: venue or resort media kit with written permission (Gmail draft request, never sent by an agent); Seychelles Tourism Board media library only if its licence terms cover commercial blog use by a third party ([[VERIFY licence]], record terms, credit and expiry in library-index.csv); licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to the register. Never AI, never a competitor, directory, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image. Location proven by media kit, register row or EXIF, never by appearance.
